Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Observed: side-view mossy cavern with a white-masked, red-cloaked character. Controls used: Left/Right movement, Z jump, X attack, C dash, and A bind. Short jump taps and dash attempts often produced no visible effect; directional jumps sometimes succeeded. Health is shown by five mask icons at upper left. Masks darken after damage, and all masks restore after respawn. The green pit creature repeatedly damaged the character, and repeated falls eventually caused death and respawn.

Layout: the checkpoint is beside a huge ornate green sphere. Right of it is a mossy wall dead end; the character can disappear into the foliage but returns left. Left of the checkpoint, a raised mossy ledge is reachable by jumping. Thick vine trunks periodically obstruct walking and require jumps to pass. The ledge ends at a darker cavern with a glowing hanging cocoon, a wide gap, a small floating platform, and a foliage pit below. A spiky green creature occupies the pit. A pale cocoon was also seen at the pit's far left.

Failed strategies: walking left, jumps, dash, and combined jump-dash attempts did not cross the gap and repeatedly dropped the character into the damaging pit. Retreat-right-and-jump returned to the ledge, but each cycle caused damage until death. Attacks and upward jumps produced no exit, and the cocoon's relevance remains untested.

Active goal: find a real exit, likely by crossing or bypassing the left gap without falling into the pit. Unresolved: whether a better-timed running jump can reach the platform, and whether the cocoon, pale object, creature, or bind ability is relevant. No other route has been found.
